shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!*node_modules*'"' -g '"'!*.lock'"' | sed -n '1,240p'"

/bin/bash -lc "for f in package.json tsconfig.json next.config.ts components/AppProvider.js styles/globals.css pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js pages/404.js pages/index.js pages/blog/index.js 'pages/blog/[id].js' pages/api/posts/index.js 'pages/api/posts/[id].js'; do echo \"===== "'$f"; sed -n '"'1,260p' \""'$f"; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && test -d node_modules && echo node_modules-present || echo node_modules-missing && npm ls next react react-dom --depth=0'
/bin/bash -lc "git diff -- package.json && git log -1 --oneline --decorate && find . -maxdepth 3 -type f -not -path './node_modules/*' -not -path './.git/*' | sort"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,240p' .gitignore && find .next -maxdepth 3 -type f 2>/dev/null | sed -n '1,100p'"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n \"RouteContext|PageProps|generateStaticParams|export.*revalidate\" node_modules/next/types node_modules/next/dist -g '*.d.ts' | sed -n '1,180p'"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,260p' .next/types/validator.ts && sed -n '1,180p' .next/types/routes.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc 'git status --short && find app components -type f -maxdepth 6 | sort && for f in $(find app components -type f | sort); do echo "===== $f"; sed -n '"'1,280p' \""'$f"; done && echo '"'===== tsconfig.json' && sed -n '1,240p' tsconfig.json && echo '===== styles/globals.css tail' && tail -80 styles/globals.css"

/bin/bash -lc 'rmdir pages/blog pages/api/posts pages/api pages && test ! -d pages && echo '"'pages directory removed' && rg -n \"next/(router|head|document)|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|NextApi(Request|Response)|AppProps\" . -g '"'!node_modules/**'"' -g '"'!.next/**'"' || true"
/bin/bash -lc 'npx next typegen'
/bin/bash -lc 'npx tsc --noEmit'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm start -- --port 3100'

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e 'const body = await (await fetch(\"http://127.0.0.1:3100/blog/1\")).text(); const index = body.indexOf(\"Comments\"); console.log(body.slice(index, index + 180));'"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- .gitignore tsconfig.json styles/globals.css components/AppProvider.js pages && sed -n '1,120p' next-env.d.ts && sed -n '1,220p' tsconfig.json"
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,280p' __agent_eval__/run.mjs"

/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && test ! -d pages && find app -type f | sort && find . -path '"'./node_modules' -prune -o -path './.next' -prune -o -type f \\( -name '*.js' -o -name '*.jsx' \\) -print && rg -n \"next/(router|head|document)|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|router\\.isFallback\" app components || true"
/bin/bash -lc 'npx tsc --noEmit'

/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check && test ! -d pages && rg -n "from ['"'\\\"]next/(router|head|document)['\\\"]|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|router\\.isFallback\" app components || true && git status --short"
